memory_candidates.content: When a task describes cross-repository hand-off work as if none of it has started, check the OTHER repository's own task-management system (specs/TODO.md, git log) before planning implementation -- it may run an independent task lifecycle that already landed adjacent work targeting the same upstream commit. In this case ModelChecker's own tasks 197/207 had already implemented 3 of 6 described hand-off items (echo comparison, ensure_ascii=False producer pin, acceptance-field default) on the same day this task was dispatched, referencing the exact BimodalLogic commit (d55e2760e) the new work built on.

A negative-result audit (searching for a target that turns out not to exist -- e.g. 'audit out-of-repo Lean consumers of a changed constructor') is a valid, complete research finding. Confirm via filesystem-wide search (all sibling checkouts, not just the one named in the task) before concluding, then document the negative result explicitly so later phases don't re-search for a nonexistent target.
